heading: There is a problem signing you in
problemCancelled: You were not signed in. If you meant to sign in, try again.
problemExpired: Your sign in timed out or was started somewhere else. Try again from this page.
problemUnavailable: Sign in is not available at the moment because the service could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes.
problemRejected: We could not confirm who you are, so you have not been signed in. Try again, and contact us if this keeps happening.
helpHtml: If this keeps happening, contact the API Marketplace team.
